reviews.title: Terrible Experience
reviews.text:
Been a Nugs Subscriber for 7 years now.  Always a great experience until they pulled all the Grateful Dead music off the app and then came up with the Play Dead app.  I contacted them and said it was pretty lame to all of a sudden pull all the Dead music off the app because that was one of the reasons I was a subscriber.  They gave me a month free so I could check it out.  Fair enough they also said since I was a nugs member I would get a bundle deal of $49.99 year for the play dead app.  My trial expired and I want to subscribe and was then charged $99.99 for the year not $49.99 which I was promised.  Customer service was a total joke and finally after going back and forth they finally said no deal or bundles if you pay through the app with apple, but that’s the only way to pay it appears.  Not really happy.  Update:
My update is to just let everybody know they have quite literally the worst customer service.  Nowhere does it say anywhere that I can find that if you go through their website you can find bundle deals.  Why wouldn’t that be somewhere on the app, or when you click the stream now button.

reviews.title: Not great for downloaded shows
reviews.text: This app might be great to stream live shows but downloading a show that you are paying for separately has been terrible experience. All sorts of bugs at the website and you can’t access downloaded shows on app if your account is linked to SiriusXM account (which they don’t tell you until after the fact). Now I’m having issues actually downloading the show from their site to my PC as well (error at the site). Support has been good, but it should not take getting support involved for these basic tasks.

reviews.title: Redesign improved experience but still yikes
reviews.text:
Apple tv user. I cant fast forward in anything other than ten second skips? Im on 47th min of string cheese as i write this. My finger has pushed my remote 1000 times. Still terrible techno and “please stay tuned” Truly miserable UX.
Next issue: no soundboard access on the TV? You are a streaming platform guys and all i see on apple tv is live streams. I want to hear soundboards. Why you not include half the reason people buy your service on an app is beyond me. Issue 3: make browsing for sound board simple where it is available on a phone. It took me forever to find sort by year. Its impossible to just easily browse for archive soundboards. It like purposefully chaotic and difficult to find music. And that was for portugal the man which has a very small live catalog. Stylistically the old nugs sucked but it had a functional purpose. This is just like an ai slopped rehash that sure looks pretty but is missing key functionality to get it to a premium place.

Test your users for feedback. Its crazy to me it took 10 years to get a redesign and yet you guys still miss the mark so bigly.

reviews.title: No “Sort” option for Playlists
reviews.text:
The only way to sort/arrange songs in a playlist is by manually dragging each song, one-by-one, from the very bottom of the playlist where they’re added up to wherever you want it. If you want to sort alphabetically (Artist, Song Title, Album/Show/Venue), Recently Added to Playlist, or most importantly: Date of Show; you’re out of luck. Given the live music angle of this platform, there should also be an option to sort by Song Length or even Song Popularity. 

Every music streaming platform (including Internet Archive) has a Sort By button and some assortment of the features mentioned above. I don’t mind spending extra time on custom playlists if I’m adamant about specific songs being positioned in a specific place, but there is no reason why arranging playlists on the fly according to some broad, simple metrics like date or alphabetical order should take more than a single press of a button. 

I’m very happy with the selection & quality of music available, but the less time I can spend staring at & swiping around my phone to manage my library and more time I can spend simply listening to & enjoying the music while going about my business, the better. PLEASE implement better playlist management options as soon as possible — the future of my paid subscription depends on it.

reviews.title: Stop making me review you every day it's obnoxious
Loved it, now not so much
reviews.text:
Nugs used to be my go to for live music. They always handled things very well. Recently with the Grateful Dead 60 at Golden Gate Park, I preordered the audio download of that show. My understanding is that something with the band stopped them from releasing it at the advertised time. At which point I requested a refund and was
At first brushed off and then Completely ignored. Now something like six months later they are finally giving refunds for this show. Very disappointing. Won’t trust giving them money again. Held my money for 6 months without ever delivering the content ordered.

reviews.title: Can we finally get an app for streaming video?
reviews.text:
Crazy to think they can’t be bothered to provide an app for Roku or smart tv’s. The only real option is to airplay or hook a computer up to your tv. AirPlay always glitches and for the amount they charge I shouldn’t have to drag my laptop into my living room to watch a D&c livestream I paid close to $30 dollars for on top of my subscription fee. 

Great selection of shows but I’m about to cancel my subscription if they don’t do something about the lack of options for streaming video.
